metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochromatic Portrait with Teal Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait featuring a central figure in a dynamic pose, overlaid with large, wide-tracked teal serif typography.
triggerTerms: monochrome fashion portrait with teal text
chiaroscuro studio photography with serif overlay
high-contrast black and white album cover style
excludeWhen: busy or complex backgrounds are needed
hand-drawn or script typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic black and white photograph of a person in a leaning, sculptural pose against a dark gradient background, bisected horizontally by a large, vibrant teal serif title and a smaller white subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast lighting defining the subject's silhouette against a dark void
Vibrant teal typography providing a sharp color contrast to the monochromatic image
Horizontal text placement cutting across the verticality of the subject's pose
Negative space in the upper left and lower right balancing the central figure
coreInvariants: Monochromatic grayscale photography for the subject
Chiaroscuro lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally, leaning diagonally from the top right toward the bottom left, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large teal display text serves as the primary visual anchor, grounding the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the subject's body, interrupted by the horizontal line of the text, then down to the smaller subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the form and the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark gray (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light gray (highlights on the subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photography; high saturation contrast between the teal text and the grayscale image.
paletteRestrictions: Single accent color for primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high contrast and wide proportions
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
Wide, open counters in the 'A' and 'R'
Horizontal crossbars positioned at the optical center
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a smaller, low-contrast slab serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serif structure of the display text.
Matches the slab serif characteristics of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a person in a dynamic, leaning pose against a dark, vignetted background. Ensure strong highlights on the skin and clothing to create a sculptural effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of large, wide-tracked teal serif text across the center. Below and to the right of this, add a smaller line of white slab-serif text in lowercase.

verificationChecks: Is the main text a vibrant teal color?
Is the tracking on the main title wide and airy?
Does the text overlap the subject without obscuring key features?

mustRedesign: Any use of color in the photograph
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast tonal range in the image
Confirm the subtitle is lowercase and right-aligned
Check that the subject's silhouette is clearly defined
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Portrait + High-Contrast Lighting + Wide-Tracked Teal Serif Display Type
